title: A Rivergate for the Wreck
author: A. M. Fairweather
blurb: Petra Brightwater, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
